chunks: (Remember) Qarun, Pharaoh and Haman to whom Moses came with clear signs; but they were haughty (and oppressed) the land. Yet they could not run away from Us;

key_terms.قَارُون: Qarun (Korah), a wealthy companion of Pharaoh
key_terms.هَامَانَ: Haman, a high official or minister of Pharaoh

ai.seo_question: Who are Qarun, Pharaoh, and Haman in the context of Surah Al-Ankabut?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the triad of tyranny—Pharaoh (political power), Haman (administrative elite), and Qarun (wealth)—who rejected Moses (AS) despite clear proofs, illustrating the Shia scholarly view that arrogance leads to inevitable downfall. Their collective hubris serves as a timeless warning against the misuse of power and resources in defiance of divine truth.
